Dear Madam
Perhaps the book is out of print – My own private copy of ‘[What to Read](/book/196)’ is one in sheets, the extras having been given away – so that [RTS](/organisation/35) may have been taken out later. I have not the Half Hours still, I must have given them away or lent them, and so I cannot refer to them for the publisher[^1]

Yours truly,

C M Yonge


[^1]: It is not at all clear what book is referred to here, and CMY herself does not seem to have published a book of this name.

However, a book did appear called Sunny Half-Hours: pleasant tales at pleasant times.

By Aunt Charlotte (London: Dean 1876).
